id: title:Gilbert09:classify concurrent report quota 429 as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification and regression tests to warehouse ingestion, allowing automatic recovery from temporary concurrency quota exhaustion.
review.reason: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning transient, self-recovering error messages while retaining existing non-retryable handling; P1.F1.H1. Adds a test asserting the concurrent query quota error is classified as retryable and not non-retryable; P1.F2.H2.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and test, not on unverified outcomes such as actual recovery or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set of transient, self-recovering error messages, while retaining existing non-retryable error handling.
observations.code_quote: return {"exhausted; please wait for previous requests to complete"}
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion pipeline to distinguish between permanent account failures and temporary concurrency quota exhaustion, enabling automatic retry and recovery without manual intervention.

observations.behavior: Adds a test importing a shared error matching utility and a new test asserting that the concurrent query quota error is classified as retryable and not non-retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and verification that the transient quota exhaustion error is handled correctly and does not incorrectly disable the warehouse connector.
